mechanism: Both drugs are nephrotoxic and can cause electrolyte abnormalities (hypocalcemia, hypomagnesemia); foscarnet chelates divalent cations which may impair micafungin efficacy.
action: Monitor renal function, serum electrolytes (calcium, magnesium), and mycological response closely; adjust dosing based on creatinine clearance and consider alternative antifungal if renal function deteriorates.
